description: Sorting decimals goes through decimal.compare, for example by a reduce that picks the largest.
program: (let [d (fn [s] (match (decimal.parse s) (some x) x none (decimal.from-int 0)))] (decimal.show (reduce (fn [m x] (if (> (decimal.compare x m) 0) x m)) (d "-1") [(d "2.5") (d "10") (d "9.99")])))
